{{Nav Games Header}}

<b>Bosses</b> are unique [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They typically have higher health and deal more damage than the standard creatures in the same area. [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] may have to defeat a boss to access a new [[Areas (Silksong)|area]], acquire an [[Items (Silksong)|item]], complete a [[Quests_(Silksong)|Quest]], or simply further the main story of the game.

When Hornet encounters a boss, their name appears on-screen, and the music typically changes into a battle theme.

Not including bosses with repeated fights, there are 43 bosses in <i>Hollow Knight: Silksong</i>; counting repeated fights, there are 47 bosses.

== Trivia ==
* [[Plasmified Zango]] is the only boss that does not use a battle theme.
* The bosses which can be [[Black-Threading|black-threaded]] in [[Act 3]] are: 
**The double [[Moss Mother]] fight in [[Weavenest Atla]].
***A single black-threaded Moss Mother is in the [[Moss Grotto]] during Act 3. Unlike other Moss Mother encounters, this one lacks a title card and boss music.
**[[Moorwing]] if it was skipped initially
**Both versions of [[Savage Beastfly]]
**The [[Skull Tyrant]] in [[the Marrow]]
**[[Disgraced Chef Lugoli]]
**The enemies that [[Forebrothers Signis & Gron]] summon become black-threaded in Act 3, though Signis & Gron themselves do not.
* A reward for the third-to-last tier in the Kickstarter campaign allowed backers to create their own bosses. It is mentioned in the Kickstarter campaign that three people pledged to this tier. Two of the backer-created bosses are [[God Tamer]] in <i>Hollow Knight</i> and [[Skarrsinger Karmelita]] in <i>Silksong</i>. The third was [[Cut Content (Silksong)/Enemies#Steel Assassin Sharpe|Steel Assassin Sharpe]], who was also supposed to debut in <i>Silksong</i> but has since been delayed and will return later on.<ref name="bloomberg" />
** Three bosses from the "create your own dungeon" reward tier were also achieved, with one being [[Crust King Khann]] released in <i>Silksong</i>, with his dungeon being the [[Coral Tower]]. The other two dungeon bosses have not had any further direct mention, but will eventually be added, as Team Cherry have promised to "deliver on all of [their] obligations".<ref name="bloomberg">[https://www.bloomberg.com/news/newsletters/2025-11-28/the-makers-of-hollow-knight-silksong-aren-t-done-just-yet The Makers of 'Silksong' Aren't Done Just Yet]</ref> 
* Playtester [[Matt Trobbiani]] has stated that bosses were "much harder" during his 2025 pre-release playthrough, though some like Trobbio were "pretty much the same."<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3p5A7mQDlLg Interview with Matt Trobbiani]</ref>
